How to Register a Trademark & Brand Name in Pakistan with IPO Pakistan

An exhaustive intellectual property masterclass for Pakistani startups, software houses, e-commerce stores, and corporate brands on securing brand names, logos, and SaaS trademarks through the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (IPO).

ADVAQ Pakistan IP & Trademark Team
12 Min Read · Updated July 2026
IPO Pakistan Trademarks Ordinance 2001
Trademark Registration Key Milestones
Official Search Report

Conduct pre-filing IPO database search (Form TM-55) to verify name availability and avoid objections.

Form TM-1 Application

Official application submission establishing filing priority date and immediate ™ symbol usage rights.

Trademark Journal Notice

Grants exclusive statutory brand ownership across Pakistan and authorization to use the ® registered mark.

1. Why Register Your Trademark with IPO Pakistan?

Operating under the Ministry of Commerce, IPO Pakistan (Intellectual Property Organization) is the sole statutory authority governing trademark registration under the Trademarks Ordinance 2001.

Securing a trademark grants exclusive legal authority over your brand name, logo mark, and product taglines across Pakistan, empowering you to block competitors from copying your brand identity.

2. Selecting Nice Trademark Classes (Class 9 & 42 for Tech)

Trademarks in Pakistan are categorized under the international Nice Classification System comprising 45 distinct classes:

Nice ClassBusiness Industry CategoryCovered Goods & Services
Class 9Software Products & HardwareDownloadable software applications, mobile apps, SaaS code.
Class 42IT Consultancy & Web DevelopmentCustom software development, cloud hosting, IT consulting services.
Class 35Business & Digital MarketingE-commerce store branding, digital advertising agency services.
Class 38Telecommunications & Call CentersVoIP communications, call center services, data transmission.

3. Step-by-Step TM-1 Application Filing Workflow

Filing a trademark application at the Trademark Registry (TMR):

Step 1: Conduct Official Search (Form TM-55)

Submit an official search query to verify no conflicting marks exist in your designated Nice Class.

Step 2: Submit Form TM-1 Application

File Form TM-1 along with brand logos, applicant CNIC/SECP details, and Form TM-48 (Power of Attorney).

Step 3: Receive TM Application Number

IPO issues an official application number, giving you immediate statutory rights to use the ™ symbol.

4. Examination, Journal Publication & Certificate Issuance

Following examination, the Registrar publishes your mark in the monthly IPO Trademark Journal:

Journal Notice & Certificate Timeline:

1. 2-Month Notice Period: Allows any third party to file a Notice of Opposition (Form TM-5).

2. Certificate Issuance: If no opposition is received, pay final registration fees to receive the 10-Year Trademark Certificate granting ® symbol rights.
